template.name: NCR
columns: Drawing No./ Standard / Procedure / Contract violated

The full document number is printed directly under the title 'NON-CONFORMANCE REPORT' at the top centre of page 1, in the form NN-NCR-SCP-XXX-NNN (example: 03-NCR-SCP-ELE-003). Return ONLY the part that comes after 'SCP-', copied verbatim with its hyphen and its leading zeros — from that example return exactly: ELE-003. Do not return the whole number, do not drop the letters, and do not return the digits alone.
column_instructions.Discipline: Derive this from the value you returned for the 'NCR No.' column, not from the body of the document. If it starts with 'ELE' the discipline is Electrical. If it starts with 'CIV' or 'CE' it is Civil. If it starts with 'MEC' or 'ME' it is Mechanical. If it starts with 'PM' it is General. If the prefix is none of these, leave the column empty instead of guessing.
column_instructions.Date Issued: The date printed in the cell to the right of the label 'Issuance Date' in the upper block of page 1. It is often written as a month name with a day and a year (example: JUN 21, 2026.). Return it as DD/MM/YYYY — that example becomes 21/06/2026. Never take any other date on the page here, and in particular never take the NCR Closure date.
column_instructions.Originator/ Person: The person's NAME only, taken from the 'Reported By' row of the table whose header row reads 'This | Name | Position | Signature'. Return the content of the Name cell alone: do not append the Position (such as 'Electrical Engineer') and do not use the 'Validated By' or 'Concurred By' rows.
column_instructions.Area: The text inside the cell to the right of the label 'Part/Item Location' in the upper block of page 1 (example: GSUT HV duct bank). Copy it verbatim. Do not use the 'Part/Item Description' cell, and do not use the OWNER or CONTRACTOR header cells.
column_instructions.Description of NCR: The full text of the section headed 'Description of Non-Conformance' only, copied verbatim and completely, without summarising or rewording. Stop at the end of that box: never include the 'Reported By / Validated By / Concurred By' rows, the ROOT CAUSE section, or the ACTION PLAN section.
column_instructions.Drawing No./ Standard / Procedure / Cont: Read the small table under the heading 'References: Drawing No./ Standard / Procedure / Contract violated'. Its columns are Number, Rev, Title, Section. For every row that actually contains content, return 'Number - Title' (example: CE-300040 - cable raceway site works ITP). Skip completely empty rows, ignore the Rev and Section columns, and if the same Title repeats in more than one row do not repeat it. If more than one filled row remains, separate them with ' | '.
column_instructions.Classification of Non-Conformance: In the section headed 'Classification of Non-conformance (mark with a ✓)' every option has a small checkbox to the LEFT of its label. Return EVERY option whose box carries a visible mark (✓, x, a filled box, or a shaded box) — marking more than one option is normal and common in this form, so never stop at the first one you find. Separate multiple values with ', ' in the order they appear on the page. The only allowed values are exactly: Project Management, Planning and Control, Transportation, Health and Safety, Environmental, Construction, QA/QC, Engineering, Equipment Damage, Owner Complaint, Document Control, Others, Material. An empty box (☐) is NOT selected, and the mere presence of a printed label never means it is selected. If no box in the whole section is marked, leave the column empty.
column_instructions.Non-Conformance Level: Directly under the heading 'NON-CONFORMANCE LEVEL' there are exactly three options, each with a checkbox to the LEFT of its label: Low, Medium, High. Return only the one whose box carries a visible mark (✓, x, a filled box, or a shaded box); normally exactly one of the three is marked. If none of the three is marked, leave the column empty — never infer the level from the severity of the description text.
column_instructions.Cause of Non-Conformance: The full text under the heading 'ROOT CAUSE:' — the band that sits between the 'Concurred By' row and the 'ACTION PLAN:' heading. Copy it verbatim and completely, without summarising. If the ROOT CAUSE band exists but is blank, leave the column empty.
column_instructions.Corrective Action: The full text written to the right of the label 'Proposed Corrective (Remedial) Action', inside the ACTION PLAN section. Copy it verbatim and completely, without summarising. If the cell is blank, leave the column empty.
column_instructions.Preventive Action: The full text written to the right of the label 'Proposed Preventive Action', inside the ACTION PLAN section. Copy it verbatim and completely, without summarising. If the cell is blank, leave the column empty.
column_instructions.Status: Exactly one of two values: Closed or Open. Look only at the cell to the right of the label 'NCR Closure date' near the bottom of page 1; the date in it is usually handwritten. If any readable date is present there, return Closed. If that cell is blank, return Open. Never decide this from signatures, stamps, or the wording of the corrective action.
column_instructions.Date Closed: The date in the cell to the right of the label 'NCR Closure date' near the bottom of page 1. It is usually handwritten and often uses dots as separators (example: 25.06.2026). Return it as DD/MM/YYYY — that example becomes 25/06/2026. Read the digits from the shape of the ink only, and never copy the Issuance Date into this column. If the cell is blank, leave it empty.
column_instructions.Work/Rework/ Rejected: Leave it empty unless the document states one of these three words explicitly as the disposition of the non-conformance. Never infer it from the wording of the corrective or preventive action.
